evidence.quote: close infrastructure side channels that are high-bandwidth and easily discoverable by agents.

text: safety case 지침은 명확한 threshold 가 있는 monitorability 평가와 held-out 평가에서 지난 사건에 대한 높은 recall 을 요구한다

evidence.quote: Enforce monitorability: Ensure models remain monitorable, as measured by monitorability and monitor evasion evals with clear thresholds, to catch concerning behavior early.
High recall on known issues: Ensure the monitoring system has high recall on past incidents in a held-out eval.

text: safety case 지침은 senior leadership 이 검토하고 각자 run 을 거부할 수 있어야 한다고 적는다

evidence.quote: Approvals: The safety case should be reviewed by members of senior leadership, who should each have the ability to veto the run

text: safety case 지침은 다른 팀의 반대 의견서, 감사자의 확인, 남은 위험의 목록을 요구한다

evidence.quote: Dissents (pre-mortems): After a safety case is drafted, a member of another team should write a dissent to find potential holes in the safety case
Audits: Auditors should be provided with sufficient access to verify that the claims of the safety case are valid and sound, and to raise gaps if found.
Residual risk completeness: Safety cases should enumerate a comprehensive list of residual risks which are not covered by currently implemented mitigations

text: 격리 글은 재개를 누가 승인했는지, 반대 의견서, 감사, 남은 위험 목록, red-teaming 에 쓴 모델이 학습 run 의 checkpoint 인지, 공격 전에 safety analysis 를 거쳤는지, 느리지 않은 채널이 있었는지를 적지 않는다

text: safety case 지침은 심각한 misalignment 사건을 조사할 때 할 수 있는 일의 예로 postmortem, 사건에서 만든 평가를 regression test 로 두는 일, 조사가 끝난 뒤 결과 공개를 든다

evidence.quote: We also have been developing some best practices for investigating severe AI misalignment incidents.
Some examples of such actions could include:
Postmortem: An operational and cultural postmortem should be conducted to understand all contributing causes to the incident
Incident-derived evals should be created as “regression tests,” to ensure future models do not exhibit propensity for misalignment on very similar incidents.
Public disclosures: Investigation results, postmortems, and operational changes should be shared with the public following the conclusion of the investigation.

text: safety case 지침은 기록 보존과 monitoring 을 끌 수 없게 하는 항목을 RL 학습, 평가, 내부 배포에 함께 적용하라고 적는다

evidence.quote: Immutable transcripts: Save agent transcripts immutably for a reasonable period of time (for example, in write-once storage accounts) for all RL training, evaluation, and internal deployment
or to disable the monitor from within RL training, evaluation, or an internal deployment
